entries.t: <FACE:99>Hey! You there, kid!<NL>Know a guy, Rintaro?
<FACE:00>I see, so he's here<NL>too… Could it be…
<FACE:99>I'm asking if you've<NL>seen him or not!
<FACE:00>No… I don't know him<WAIT><FACE:00>Do you guys know that<NL>Rintaro person?
<FACE:99>This is why total<NL>amateurs are a pain!<WAIT>I'm that Rintaro's<NL>mentor, I tell ya!
<FACE:9A>We drilled the ABCs of<NL>Robattling into him!
<FACE:99>You idiots!<NL><WAIT>Around here we settle<NL>it with pure skill!!
<FACE:99>Oh! You doubt me, huh!<NL>Then we Robattle!!
<FACE:00>Yeah, you're good<NL><WAIT>That was a fine match<NL><WAIT>…By the way, I'm<NL><PLAYER><WAIT>Do you know a Hikaru<NL>or a Shiden?
<FACE:99>Tch…<NL>Never heard of 'em!<WAIT><FACE:00>If you do see them…
